en.name: Grapeseed oil
en.summary: Grapeseed oil keeps 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard with the cap tight. It is a by-product of winemaking, extracted from the pips left after pressing, and it is the most polyunsaturated of the common neutral oils — which is why it is the one in this cupboard to buy in the smallest bottle you can find.
en.pantry: 1 year from purchase, cool, dark, tightly capped. Rancidity is a reaction between oxygen and the double bonds in unsaturated fat, and grapeseed oil is unusually full of them, more so than canola and far more so than olive. Two things about how it is sold make that worse. It nearly always comes in clear glass, so it has been absorbing light on a brightly lit shop shelf before you ever got it home, and light drives oxidation directly while the bottle offers no protection at all. And it is often sold in large bottles as an everyday healthy cooking oil, which is the wrong size for the fastest-oxidising oil on the shelf. Get it out of the light — inside a cupboard, or decanted into something dark — and buy the small one next time.
en.fridge: No refrigerated figure is published for grapeseed oil. The fridge genuinely helps here more than it does with steadier oils, and for a big bottle that has to survive a Taiwanese summer it is worth the shelf space; the oil goes cloudy and thick when cold, which is harmless and reverses on the counter. If the choice is between refrigerating a large bottle and buying the smallest one each time, buy the small one — you get fresher oil and your fridge back.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is published, and there is no point freezing it. Oil stiffens instead of setting, so you gain nothing but a bottle that will not pour, and each journey between freezer and warm kitchen leaves water condensing on the glass and eventually in the oil. Pure oil is one of the few foods that offers bacteria and moulds nothing whatsoever; adding water undoes that.
en.thawing: Stand a cold bottle on the counter until the cloud clears and it pours freely. Never warm it in hot water or over the hob. Heat is one of the four things that age an oil, and this is the oil with the least tolerance for any of them.
spoilage: A sharp, crayon or paint-like smell — rancid oil, and decisive.
A bitter, scratchy finish at the back of the throat.
A sticky, varnish-like film around the neck and cap.
Colour noticeably darker or duller than when the bottle was opened.
tips: Buy small bottles; this is the oil least forgiving of a slow half-bottle.
Never store it above the hob.
Smell it before using it in a dressing, where there is nothing to hide behind.

faq.q: How long does grapeseed oil last?
faq.a: 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard with the cap tight.

faq.q: Why does grapeseed oil go rancid faster than olive oil?
faq.a: It is much more polyunsaturated, and it is the double bonds in unsaturated fat that oxygen attacks. More double bonds means faster rancidity.
No timeline is published for it, but refrigeration slows oxidation and suits a large bottle used slowly. It will cloud in the cold, which is harmless.

zh.name: 葡萄籽油
zh.summary: 葡萄籽油自購買日起，放陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊，可放 1 年。它是釀酒的副產品，從壓榨後剩下的葡萄籽取油，也是常見中性油裡多元不飽和脂肪最高的一種——所以它是整個油櫃裡最該買最小瓶的那一瓶。
zh.pantry: 自購買日起 1 年，陰涼、避光、鎖緊瓶蓋。油耗是氧氣和不飽和脂肪裡雙鍵發生的反應，而葡萄籽油的雙鍵特別多，比芥花油還多，更遠多於橄欖油。它的販售方式又讓情況雪上加霜。第一，它幾乎都裝在透明玻璃瓶裡，在你買回家之前，就已經在燈火通明的貨架上吸了一路的光；光會直接推動氧化，而那個瓶子提供不了任何保護。第二，它常常以日常健康用油的名義賣大瓶裝，而那對架上氧化最快的油來說是錯誤的尺寸。請把它從光線裡移開——收進櫃子，或分裝到深色容器——下次買小瓶的。
zh.fridge: 葡萄籽油沒有公布的冷藏期限。冷藏對它的幫助確實比對那些穩定的油更明顯，一瓶必須撐過台灣夏天的大容量，值得占用那格空間；油冰過會變濁變稠，那是無害的，回到檯面就恢復。如果選項是把一大瓶冰起來，還是每次買最小的那一瓶，請買小瓶：你得到更新鮮的油，也把冰箱空間拿回來。
zh.freezer: 沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且冷凍它毫無意義。油在低溫下只是變硬變稠而不會凝固，你什麼都沒得到，只得到一瓶倒不出來的油；而每一趟在冷凍庫和溫暖廚房之間的往返，都會讓水氣凝在瓶身、最後凝進油裡。純油是少數完全不提供細菌和黴菌任何養分的食物；加了水，這個優勢就沒了。
zh.thawing: 把冰過的瓶子放在檯面上，等濁度散去、倒得順了再用。絕對不要泡熱水或放在爐火上加溫。熱是讓油老化的四個因素之一，而這瓶油對其中任何一個的容忍度都最低。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆味——油耗了，而且是決定性的。
入口後喉頭有苦味和刮喉感。
瓶頸和瓶蓋周圍出現黏黏、像亮光漆的膜。
顏色比剛開瓶時明顯變深或變濁。
tips: 買小瓶；這是最禁不起「半瓶慢慢用」的一種油。
絕對不要放在爐台上方。
拿來做沙拉醬前先聞一下，那裡沒有任何味道可以遮掩它。

faq.a: 自購買日起，陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊，1 年。

faq.q: 葡萄籽油為什麼比橄欖油更快油耗？
faq.a: 它的多元不飽和脂肪多得多，而氧氣攻擊的正是不飽和脂肪裡的雙鍵。雙鍵越多，油耗越快。
它沒有公布冷藏期限，但冷藏能拖慢氧化，適合用得慢的大瓶裝。低溫下會變濁，那是無害的。
